text:
maria-ops: FYI — ACME HW POC just asked if we can ingest their SOC2 bundle + recent pen-test into the marketplace evidence store. They want a single handoff for the joint listing. Launch window is Friday, we need a decision by Wed.

sam-platform: ok. Do we want them to upload to our ingest bucket or provide presigned tarball?

jess-legal: If they upload, we need an attestation form + liability redaction checklist. Prefer presigned so they keep control of raw items, but we still need signed attestation that no PII remains.

oliver-sec: presigned is fine. Important: pen-test report includes attacker IP logs we MUST redact. Also need scannable hash manifest and proof of signature for chain-of-custody.

maria-ops: timeline: Wed EOD decisions, Thu ingest/redaction run, Fri go/no-go. Can we automate redaction or is this manual?

sam-platform: we can run the standard redaction pipeline but for firmware diffs and IP logs we need manual review. Proposal: ACME presigns 2 buckets — one raw (short TTL, restricted) and one sanitized we pull into the evidence catalog. We send them a small ingestion script.

jess-legal: that pattern works if ACME signs the attestation doc. I'll draft language. Also add a clause: Redwood not responsible for 3rd-party SI artifacts containing customer data unless explicitly declared.

oliver-sec: require pen-test attestation that the tester was authorized and redaction applied. Also request a statement of scope (assets, network ranges, dates).

marketplace-bot: Upload policy reminder: "evidence_ingest_v2" requires: attestation.pdf, manifest.sha256, scope.txt, sanitized.tar.gz. Presigned links expire in 24h unless flagged.

maria-ops: Sam — can you share the ingestion script and the presign steps? Keep it minimal for ACME SI. Also add an explicit field in the manifest for "contains-firmware: true/false".

sam-platform: yes. Pasting quick example for ACME:
```bash
# generate presign on S3 (example)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme/poctar.gz --expires-in 86400
# ACME uploads sanitized.tar.gz to that URL
```
I'll attach a small wrapper that validates manifest.sha256 and required files before we start transfer.

jess-legal: thanks. I'll post attestation template in #legal later today. Make sure it asks for tester identity and retention window.

oliver-sec: note — we'll schedule a 30min witness call with ACME and the pen-test firm to confirm redaction steps before ingest. Who owns scheduling?

maria-ops: I'll own scheduling. Propose Thu 10am PT. If anyone can't make it, record and add a short checklist.

sam-platform: I'll prep the ingest lambda and add a flag to mark artifacts as "partner-managed" so we don't auto-publish in the public listing until legal sign-off.

jess-legal: perfect. One more ask: include a field in the manifest for "press-embargo: yyyy-mm-dd" so marketing knows when to announce.

maria-ops: good call. ACME said embargo is 2026-04-10. Add that to the intake form.

oliver-sec: final security ask: keep raw artifacts in a locked KMS key with access logs for 90 days, then move sanitized to long-term store.

sam-platform: doable. I'll ensure KMS policy and retention are in the runbook.

maria-ops: summary action items — sam: presign + ingest script + flagging; jess: attestation + legal clause; oliver: witness call & redaction checklist; me: schedule and confirm embargo. Target: Wed EOD decision, Thu ingest. :thumbsup:

jess-legal: acked.

oliver-sec: ack.

marketplace-bot: Note: creating tracker ticket #PART-4219 (evidence-intake) for this flow.
